category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.rationale: The packet does not target sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling, oily or dandruff scalp; the supported production route is the ordinary balanced shampoo bucket.

category_specs.product_shampoo_specs.cle.rationale: Strong: CAPB leads the surfactant system after water, but olefin sulfonate at position 3 is reinforced by coco-glucoside, sodium cocoyl isethionate and later sulfosuccinate. The volume positioning is compatible with a stronger cleansing chassis. Observed intensity: regular.

product.suitable_thicknesses.rationale: Ideal: fine — The volume positioning is explicitly for thin/fine hair and the silicone-free formula has enough cleanser/texture support to keep fine hair in the ideal set. Conditional (not emitted): normal — Normal hair may use it for volume, but the moderate conditioning/weight route and fine-hair targeting make it less central.

required_protocol_roles.rationale: Roles derived from reviewed buckets: shampoo_everyday.

research.properties.cleansingStrength.rationale: Strong: CAPB leads the surfactant system after water, but olefin sulfonate at position 3 is reinforced by coco-glucoside, sodium cocoyl isethionate and later sulfosuccinate. The volume positioning is compatible with a stronger cleansing chassis.

research.properties.conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: macadamia oil, avocado oil, glycerin, panthenol, polyquaternium-10 and cationic guar provide real rinse-off care, but the product is not a rich 2-in-1 and has no silicone stack.

research.properties.dandruffSupport.rationale: Not supported: the complete exact-GTIN formula contains neither Piroctone Olamine nor Climbazole.

research.properties.focusPrimary.rationale: Volume: the exact product identity centers on Big Hair and supporting positioning targets fullness/body for thin or fine hair; the silicone-free multi-surfactant formula is compatible with that role.

research.properties.focusSecondary.rationale: Empty: the oil and humectant story supports care feel inside the volume product, not a separate exact-product secondary focus with an independent route.

research.properties.scalpComfortTarget.rationale: Not targeted: revealed claims target volume/fullness, not sensitive, itchy, dry-feeling or uncomfortable scalp.

research.properties.usageRole.rationale: Regular: directions are ordinary wet-hair lather and rinse-out use with no treatment, daily/frequent, alternating or reset trigger.

research.properties.weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: two plant oils plus polyquaternium-10 and cationic guar create noticeable but bounded residue potential, while the multi-surfactant, silicone-free, volume-positioned architecture keeps this below high.
